detector_input: Historical 0-1 prediction errors in label-arrival order. Only current monitoring episode and model version.
update_rule: Lock latest closed 100-event window, wait for all 100 labels, then refit ARF.
calibration: 100 new-version predictions, all labels must return.
oracle_limitation: ADWIN change detection is not fixed-window oracle classification.
evaluation_limitation: This external baseline was added after inspection of previous holdout results.
